provenance.basis: Fresh owning suites in a clean manifest-only copy; separate clean bootstrap and transfer audit

new_regressions: Unknown removed scripts/resources rejected before promotion; previous PBO and receipt retained
Nested or conflicting generated config/texture names rejected
Only explicit AddonBuilder root generated entries classified without content verification
Empty autogenerated config.cpp requires binary source and uncompressed empty entry
Builtin inventory permits no generated exceptions
Source entry casing accepted consistently; missing cpp is not excused by an existing source bin

github_ci.receipt: Hosted CI for the exact published commit is linked in its GitHub release

limitations: Scenario validation verifies reported data and file identity, not the truth of gameplay observations
File checks detect changes during reads; they do not lock files against changes after validation returns
Python and pack-only checks do not replace Enforce, client/server gameplay or performance measurements
Optional external model and corpora are not included in this portable artifact
Native AddonBuilder behavior and generated config/texture-header semantics were not tested in this release; builder tests use a controlled test process.
Asset and diagnostic skill walkthroughs validate instructions for given scenarios, not graphical conversion or game behavior.
